description: List TechCrunch events (Disrupt, StrictlyVC, Sessions, etc.) from the public WordPress REST API that powers the events page (techcrunch.com/events/ — reached via the Events link in the site nav). The page has two blocks, Upcoming Events and Past Events; use --type to choose which to list: upcoming (即将举办, default), past (已结束), or all (全部, upcoming first). Returns each event's name, URL, date, and location when the card shows one, plus a status field (upcoming/past). Past events paginate internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the list is exhausted. Event detail pages are custom-built per event, so this command intentionally returns cards only. No authentication required.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which events to list. Available: upcoming (即将举办 — future events, default), past (已结束 — finished events), all (全部 — both, upcoming first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100, default 20). Upcoming events are few (about 4 on the current site); past events paginate internally, and partial=true when the list is exhausted before reaching the limit.
